probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube in a manner that allows reading of the MTP through the test tube material without removal of the MTP from the test tube.

2. (Previously presented)

3. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term storage of biological samples at temperatures below ambient.

5. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polymer is selected to maintain structural integrity when the embedded MTP is read.

6. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system is configured to track and manage samples using the embedded MTP.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, wherein the racks and test tubes are maintained and handled at -20°C or less during storage and retrieval operations.

15. (Currently amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to embed the MTP within the plastic material.

16. (Currently amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a test tube assembly with an embedded MTP; positioning the test tube assembly in a reader device; and reading the MTP through the test tube material without removing the MTP from the test tube.

17. (Previously presented)

18. (Previously presented)

19. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer selected to withstand repeated temperature cycling and long-term storage conditions.

20. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
